posts.text: Q1FY27 Concall: This time management is more realistic with their answers, and all are convincing with good underline factors. Hedging gains: FY26 PAT has ~80-90 Cr of Inventory gains on the unhedged portion of Gold. Current Hedging is 70% and it will be improved to 80% by Q3, 100% by FY28. Stores count: FY27- 25 store openings are planned 5 COCO + 20 FOCO FY28 & FY29 would have 37 store openings in each year. Store break up at FY29 would be 113 legacy stores+ 64 life style stores (from current 13 stores). Pat margins would be ~4.7%. FY27 Guidance: Revenue would be ~13500 Cr as stated earlier,…

posts.text: Yes, this time they want to clear lot of Air so mentioned about all points in detail in the press release. image 1068×336 82.5 KB Very good highlights, Studd ratio shoot up ~11%.
